reporting.coverage_by_jurisdiction.definition: select "jurisdiction_id", "status", count(*) as "answers" from "coverage_answers" group by "coverage_answers"."jurisdiction_id", "coverage_answers"."status"
reporting.coverage_by_jurisdiction.name: coverage_by_jurisdiction

reporting.current_geo.definition: select "jurisdiction_id", "geo_kind", "centroid_lat", "centroid_lng", "min_lat", "max_lat", "min_lng", "max_lng", "geometry_hash", "precision", "effective_from", "effective_to", "verification_status" from "jurisdiction_geo" where "jurisdiction_geo"."effective_from" <= current_date and ("jurisdiction_geo"."effective_to" is null or "jurisdiction_geo"."effective_to" >= current_date)
reporting.current_geo.name: current_geo

reporting.current_rates.definition: select "tax_type_id", "jurisdiction_id", "rate_value", "rate_unit", "applies_to", "effective_from", "effective_to", "verification_status" from "tax_rates" where "tax_rates"."effective_from" <= current_date and ("tax_rates"."effective_to" is null or "tax_rates"."effective_to" >= current_date)
reporting.current_rates.name: current_rates

reporting.geo_tie_out.definition:
WITH reg AS (
    SELECT level::text AS level, count(*)::int AS n FROM jurisdictions
    WHERE (slug = 'us-tx' OR slug LIKE 'us-tx-%') AND level IN ('state','county','city','special_district')
    GROUP BY level
  ),
  geo AS (
    SELECT j.level::text AS level,
      count(DISTINCT j.id) FILTER (WHERE g.boundary_geojson IS NOT NULL)::int AS with_boundary,
      count(DISTINCT j.id) FILTER (WHERE g.boundary_geojson IS NULL AND g.geo_kind = 'centroid')::int AS centroid_only
    FROM jurisdiction_geo g JOIN jurisdictions j ON j.id = g.jurisdiction_id
    WHERE g.effective_from <= current_date AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to >= current_date)
    GROUP BY j.level
  ),
  absent AS (
    SELECT j.level::text AS level, count(DISTINCT j.id)::int AS n
    FROM coverage_answers a JOIN jurisdictions j ON j.id = a.jurisdiction_id
    WHERE a.question_key = 'has_published_boundary' AND a.status = 'confirmed_absent'
    GROUP BY j.level
  )
  SELECT r.level, r.n AS registered,
    coalesce(g.with_boundary, 0) AS with_boundary,
    coalesce(g.centroid_only, 0) AS centroid_only,
    coalesce(a.n, 0) AS confirmed_absent,
    (r.n - coalesce(g.with_boundary, 0) - coalesce(g.centroid_only, 0) - coalesce(a.n, 0))::int AS unaccounted
  FROM reg r LEFT JOIN geo g ON g.level = r.level LEFT JOIN absent a ON a.level = r.level
reporting.geo_tie_out.name: geo_tie_out

reporting.product_treatments_current.definition: select "category_id", "jurisdiction_id", "tax_type_id", "treatment", "taxable_fraction", "summary", "sourcing_rule", "effective_from", "effective_to", "verification_status" from "product_tax_treatments" where "product_tax_treatments"."effective_from" <= current_date and ("product_tax_treatments"."effective_to" is null or "product_tax_treatments"."effective_to" >= current_date)
reporting.product_treatments_current.name: product_treatments_current
